import pandas as pd

def run(inputs: dict[str, pd.DataFrame]) -> dict[str, pd.DataFrame]:
    df = inputs["meter_reads"].copy()

    # Sort ascending by meter_id, read_ts, read_seq (stable sort to preserve
    # legacy tie-breaking semantics)
    df_sorted = df.sort_values(
        by=["meter_id", "read_ts", "read_seq"],
        ascending=[True, True, True],
        kind="mergesort",
    )

    # Dedup: keep LAST row per meter_id in the sorted stream
    df_dedup = df_sorted.drop_duplicates(subset=["meter_id"], keep="last")

    # Aggregate by zone, treating NULL zone as a real group
    grouped = df_dedup.groupby("zone", dropna=False).agg(
        total_kwh=("kwh", "sum"),
        meter_count=("kwh", "size"),
    ).reset_index()

    grouped = grouped[["zone", "total_kwh", "meter_count"]]

    return {"zone_totals": grouped}
